description: V13.24 SNPE diagnostic space for a 1970 CBS-population base config. Widened seeding, contact/mixing, diagnosis, MSM-era diagnosis multiplier, and ART ranges to test whether SNPE can recover non-MSM diagnoses without using disease natural-history parameters as calibration knobs. Natural-history progression and mortality parameters are fixed to the base-config literature values.

parameters.name: orient_female
parameters.notes: Widened lower bound to allow weaker female/non-MSM contact contribution while preserving runner constraint orient_female <= 1.0.

parameters.name: orient_msm
parameters.notes: Widened upper bound for MSM contact multiplier while preserving runner constraint orient_msm >= 1.0.

parameters.name: activity_med
parameters.notes: Widened activity distribution; paired with activity_high bounds so derived Low stays inside runner bounds.

parameters.name: activity_high
parameters.notes: Widened high-activity share; paired with activity_med bounds so derived Low stays inside runner bounds.

parameters.name: seed_prevalence
parameters.notes: V13.14: widened from V13.10 [0.001, 0.0035] to [0.0005, 0.005] for burn-in exploration. Not a stress-test range — stays within defensible uncertainty. Widened downward and slightly upward to reduce forced early spikes while still allowing high-seed alternatives.

parameters.name: seed_msm_fraction
parameters.notes: Widened below 0.8 so SNPE can allocate meaningful seed infection pressure to non-MSM groups.

parameters.name: p_msm
parameters.notes: V13.9.3 MSM denominator diagnostic. Runner syncs demography.sexual_debut.p_msm.value. Modestly widened MSM denominator range for 1970 diagnostic exploration.

parameters.name: seed_msm_chronic_share
parameters.notes: V13.15: orientation-specific MSM chronic seed share; widened to match V13.14 shared chronic upper bound. Widened seed-stage maturity while preserving non-negative derived acute share.

parameters.name: seed_msm_aids_share
parameters.notes: V13.15: orientation-specific MSM AIDS seed share; widened to match V13.14 shared AIDS upper bound. Widened MSM AIDS-stage seed share while preserving non-negative derived acute share.

parameters.name: seed_non_msm_chronic_share
parameters.notes: V13.15: non-MSM chronic seed share; diagnostic upper bound allows late-presenter heterogeneity. Widened non-MSM chronic seed share to test late-presenter/non-MSM diagnosis capacity.

parameters.name: seed_non_msm_aids_share
parameters.notes: V13.15: non-MSM AIDS seed share; diagnostic upper bound above MSM to reflect later diagnosis/later presentation concern. Widened non-MSM AIDS-stage seed share to test AIDS-death and non-MSM diagnosis capacity.

parameters.name: contact_low
parameters.notes: Widened contact low group for structural-capacity exploration.

parameters.name: contact_med
parameters.notes: Widened contact medium group for structural-capacity exploration.

parameters.name: contact_high
parameters.notes: Widened contact high group for structural-capacity exploration.

parameters.name: diagnosis_1985
parameters.notes: Widened ascertainment schedule anchor; not a natural-history disease parameter.

parameters.name: diagnosis_1990
parameters.notes: Widened ascertainment schedule anchor; not a natural-history disease parameter.

parameters.name: diagnosis_1997
parameters.notes: Widened ascertainment schedule anchor; not a natural-history disease parameter.

parameters.name: diagnosis_2019
parameters.notes: Widened ascertainment schedule anchor; not a natural-history disease parameter.

parameters.name: msm_diag_mult_1996
parameters.notes: V13.21 MSM relative diagnosis early-era multiplier (1996-2003). Era-specific relative ascertainment factor; values below 1 suppress MSM diagnosis relative to base/non-MSM, values above 1 increase it. No monotonicity constraint is imposed across eras. Widened early MSM relative diagnosis multiplier.

parameters.name: msm_diag_mult_2004
parameters.notes: V13.21 MSM relative diagnosis mid-era multiplier (2004-2014). Era-specific relative ascertainment factor without cross-era monotonicity. Widened mid-era MSM relative diagnosis multiplier.

parameters.name: msm_diag_mult_2019
parameters.notes: V13.22 MSM relative diagnosis recent-era multiplier (2019+). Era-specific relative ascertainment factor without cross-era monotonicity. Widened recent MSM relative diagnosis multiplier.

parameters.name: art_init_1996
parameters.notes: Widened ART initiation anchor; intervention/program parameter, not disease natural history.

parameters.name: art_init_2000
parameters.notes: Widened ART initiation anchor; intervention/program parameter, not disease natural history.

parameters.name: art_init_2015
parameters.notes: Widened ART initiation anchor; intervention/program parameter, not disease natural history.

parameters.name: art_init_2020
parameters.notes: Widened ART initiation anchor; intervention/program parameter, not disease natural history.

parameters.name: art_dropout_rate
parameters.notes: Widened ART dropout range; intervention/program parameter, not disease natural history.

fixed_parameters.name: art_init_1995
fixed_parameters.reason: Hard no-ART anchor before the 1996 ART availability year.

fixed_parameters.name: historical_oral_prep_enabled
fixed_parameters.reason: Historical oral PrEP remains active for 2019-2025 targets.

fixed_parameters.name: historical_lenacapavir_disabled
fixed_parameters.reason: Lenacapavir was unavailable during historical calibration.

fixed_parameters.name: msm_relative_diagnosis_enabled
fixed_parameters.reason: V13.10 diagnostic pilot: activates the MSM relative diagnosis layer. This fixed parameter ensures the feature is on for every particle in this space. Not a production default.

fixed_parameters.name: diagnosis_schedule_interpolation_linear
fixed_parameters.reason: V13.22: apply linear interpolation between diagnosis schedule anchors for ABC-SMC runs.

fixed_parameters.name: msm_relative_diagnosis_interpolation_linear
fixed_parameters.reason: V13.22: apply linear interpolation between MSM-relative diagnosis multiplier anchors.

fixed_parameters.name: simulation_start_year
fixed_parameters.reason: V13.24 SNPE diagnostic: simulation starts in 1970; pass --simulation-start-year 1970 because the runner also applies a command-line start-year override.

fixed_parameters.name: seed_year
fixed_parameters.reason: 1970 population burn-in with epidemic introduction fixed at 1975; seed intensity/composition are sampled.

fixed_parameters.name: chronic_to_aids
fixed_parameters.reason: Held fixed for V13.24 SNPE diagnostic because this is a disease natural-history/literature parameter, not a calibration knob.

fixed_parameters.name: chronic_to_aids_on_art
fixed_parameters.reason: Held fixed for V13.24 SNPE diagnostic because this is a disease natural-history/literature parameter, not a calibration knob.

fixed_parameters.name: aids_mortality
fixed_parameters.reason: Held fixed for V13.24 SNPE diagnostic because this is a disease natural-history/literature parameter, not a calibration knob.

fixed_parameters.name: art_mortality_reduction
fixed_parameters.reason: Held fixed for V13.24 SNPE diagnostic because this is a disease natural-history/literature parameter, not a calibration knob.

excluded_parameters.name: seed_msm_acute_share
excluded_parameters.reason: Derived in runner as 1 - seed_msm_chronic_share - seed_msm_aids_share.

excluded_parameters.name: seed_non_msm_acute_share
excluded_parameters.reason: Derived in runner as 1 - seed_non_msm_chronic_share - seed_non_msm_aids_share.

constraints.description: MSM acute seed share must be non-negative.
non-MSM acute seed share must be non-negative.
Diagnostic orientation seed ordering: MSM AIDS seed share must not exceed non-MSM AIDS seed share.

notes: SNPE default summary stats now include derived new_diagnoses_non_msm so this run directly trains on the non-MSM diagnosis gap.
